description: Vietnam wears down stronger armies through guerrilla warfare, traps and poisoned arrows. Hideouts secure resources and support tunnel travel, while Water Buffalo work Rice Paddies for food and wood. Specialized landmarks, skirmishers and powerful gunpowder units reward careful map control.
author: hosein81 and chilly5

bonuses: Water Buffalo support Rice Paddy food and wood production.
Hideouts secure resources and can be fortified.
Bamboo traps and poisoned arrows wear down enemies.
Field specialized skirmishers and gunpowder units.
